title: Forrestal unravels, says he is followed by foreign-looking men
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Forrestal unravels, says he is followed by foreign-looking men, about 1948-1949 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like he was unraveling. He started developing these weird nervous ticks. He was said, "I'm being followed by strange foreign looking men."

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how James Forrestal, the first US Secretary of Defense, seemed to come apart in Washington in 1948 and 1949. Dolan says Forrestal developed strange nervous tics and said he was being followed by "strange foreign looking men," with figures such as the newspaper columnist Drew Pearson and Air Force secretary Stuart Symington part of the story. Dolan tells it as part of his argument that Forrestal's end was tied to UFO secrets.
